rows.label: tlk46400071_04_msg0001
rows.name: Oh dear. This is a bind...

rows.label: tlk46400071_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Thing is, there's a wreck
been washed into the harbor.

rows.label: tlk46400071_04_msg0003
rows.name:
And it's pretty big. Well, if the
truth be told, it's massive!

rows.label: tlk46400071_04_msg0004
rows.name:
I'm not sure our husbands
can handle it by themselves...

rows.label: tlk46400071_04_msg0005
rows.name:
They want to dismantle it somehow,
so I was asked to gather some people
to help.

rows.label: tlk46400071_04_msg0006
rows.name:
But there aren't many people here
who are good at heavy labor...

rows.label: tlk46400071_04_msg0007
rows.name:
Can't really ask the
refugees for help either,
so I really am in a bind.

rows.label: tlk46400071_04_msg0009
rows.name:
Then I think I'll ask you. Thank you,
that would be a huge help.

rows.label: tlk46400071_04_msg0010
rows.name:
I'm looking forward to
seeing what you can do!
